name: Oil (Brent)
summary: Brent near $94 on deal hopes, but Hormuz remains largely shut to shipping
state: Brent fell to about $94 on 4 Nov, down about 18% in a week, as Democrats won Congress and talks on a US–Iran deal continued (Yahoo Finance; ProtoThema). The price alone is in the Watch band, but Alert holds on the physical outage: Hormuz is still largely closed, and Iran says it will reopen the strait within two days only if the US meets its demands, including ending the naval blockade (Al Jazeera, 4 Nov).
for_you: Fuel and heating costs follow crude with a lag, so recent falls may take weeks to reach pump prices. Prices could move sharply either way on news from the Gulf.
rubric_hit: Major physical supply outage (Hormuz largely shut, >2 mb/d) = Alert; Brent $94 alone = Watch
basis_detail: raised above the data floor on reported events

sources.title: Al Jazeera — Iran says US reply to Hormuz plan unconvincing

why: Oil feeds inflation, transport and household budgets; price spikes have preceded most post-war recessions.
drivers: OPEC+ output, Middle East supply risk, sanctions, demand, inventories, shipping disruption.

rubric.alert: Brent > $110, or 1-month change > +30%, or a major physical supply outage (> 2 mb/d).
